caption:
Butter Chicken
meal prep friendly | high protein 

Nutrition: 
C: 23 | F: 14 | P: 42
Calories: 377 per serve 
Serves 3 - 4 depending on appetite 

Ingredients:
Spices:
6 garlic cloves | 3 cardamom pods, green| 2 whole peppercorn | 3 cloves |6 kashmiri red chilli, dried
1/2 tsp cinnamon powder ( optional ) 

Gravy:
1 tsp oil OR butter, if you want :) 
1 onion, chopped
5 medium tomatoes tomatoes, around 9 medium sized , chopped
a handful of cashew nuts
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tbsp of ketchup
1 heaping tbsp on kasturi methi
salt, to taste as per your preferece

Marinade - you can play around with the spices as per your preference of flavours
1/2 cup hung curd ( as thick as possible) 
2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp haldi powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp coriander powder
1 tbsp jeera powder
salt, to taste 
450 grams chicken breasts, cubed OR 350 grams paneer, cubed

Method:
to the pan, add in the butter and melt
add in the whole spices, mentioned above and saute them till they start turning colour
add in your onion then and saute till translucent.
follow that up with your tomatoes + cashew and allow the mix to cook covered for 10 - 15 minutes till your tomatoes are super soft and cooked through, if its dry add a little water 
let this mix cool down slightly and blitze till smooth. i add 1/2 cup - 1 cup water post blending to thin out the gravy, this gives me a thinner gravy so larger portions without the calories!! 
add your blended mix back on the stove and heat it. add in your red chilli powder + tomato puree paste + salt +1/4 cup warm water and mix . Let this cook for another 10 - 15 minutes ( you will see the gravy getting a slightly darker colour)
at this stage, you can add in your cooked tandoori chicken or tandoori paneer to the gravy
top with kasturi methi, stir it in and switch off the gas

Storage: this gravy freezes well on its own without any chicken or paneer for upto 2 months
